Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the second essay as the umpires make their way out to the middle. The Bangladesh players have taken their respective fielding positions as Rahmanullah Gurbaz and Ibrahim Zadran stride out to open the innings for Afghanistan. Taskin Ahmed has the new ball in his hand and will begin proceedings. Let's go...
... THE RUN CHASE ...

On the bowling front, the Afghan bowlers seemed slightly off their game, with each conceding over 5 runs per over. Their fielding was lackluster, and they struggled to pick up wickets during the middle overs. These factors contributed to Bangladesh posting such a substantial total on a pitch favorable for batting. To secure a victory, Afghanistan's batters will need to adopt a positive approach from the outset and prioritize preserving wickets. The upcoming second innings promises to be an intriguing battle. Stay tuned for the action.

Najmul Hossain Shanto is up for a quick chat and he says that he dedicates this century to his new-born son. Mentions that they were not too worried when they lost two wickets as the pitch was very good and they decided to bat to the situation and the merit of the ball. Claims that it is very important for them to play in a challenging tournament like the BPL as it gives them exposure to playing with strong international players. Informs that they are lucky to play with some of the legends of the team and the experience they offer is very valuable. Credits Mehidy for coming top of the order which is not easy and it shows his character. Ends by saying that the pitch is very good but they have quality in the bowling attack and they can win this match.

Bangladesh's opening batters provided a promising start, forming a solid partnership of 60 runs. However, the team lost two quick wickets. The entry of Najmul Hossain Shanto and Mehidy Hasan into the crease marked a turning point as they embarked on a magnificent partnership, amassing a remarkable 194 runs together. Unfortunately, the partnership was interrupted when Mehidy had to retire hurt due to a hamstring strain. Subsequently, Shanto and Mushfiqur Rahim were both run out within a mere 5-over span, introducing two new batters. Captain Shakib Al Hasan took charge to ensure that the team capitalized on their strong start, contributing a rapid-fire 32 off 18 balls.

Bangladesh staged an impressive comeback with the bat in their first innings against Afghanistan, amassing a formidable total of 334 for the loss of just 5 wickets. This turnaround followed a batting collapse in their previous game against Sri Lanka. The Bangladeshi batters showcased great responsibility in this must-win match, providing their bowlers with an excellent target to defend.

... MATCH DAY ...

The highly coveted Asia Cup is up and running for the 2023 edition and in Match number 4, two sides who are every day closing the gap on the world's best team go head-to-head at the Gaddafi Stadium in Lahore. Yes, it is Bangladesh vs Afghanistan in a high-octane clash as both sides look to get their best foot forward not just for this tournament but for the upcoming ODI World Cup as well. Bangladesh have already played one game in this tournament and were put to the sword by a clinical Sri Lankan side at home. This now becomes a must-win game for Bangladesh to keep their hopes of Super 4s alive. They are missing a few key players and the top order does look very inexperienced but the likes of skipper Shakib Al Hasan, Mushfiqur Rahim and Mustafizur Rahman need to come good for them here. Najmul Hossain Shanto did impress in the previous game with a fine knock of 89 runs under pressure. Taskin Ahmed has led the bowling well with his extra pace and bounce and Shoriful Islam too has been decent but they do need their batters to put on runs on the board. Afghanistan on the other hand come into the contest on the back of a whitewash against Pakistan but they did show signs that they do have the side that can beat anyone on their day. The openers, Rahmanullah Gurbaz and Ibrahim Zadran will be key for them with the bat and the bowling will once again be heavily reliant on the spin trio of Rashid Khan, Mujeeb Ur Rahman and Mohammad Nabi. Given the shortcomings in the pace department, Fazalhaq Farooqi will have to play a big role for his side with the new ball and get them those early breakthroughs. All in all, this is set up to be a tasty encounter, one which bears real significance as well. Which side will come out on top?
